title: cq agy broker reply
description: reply.json, written by the agy turn or session in its exchange job folder, in one write: UTF-8 (one UTF-8 BOM is allowed; UTF-16 and NUL bytes are refused), at most 65536 bytes, no other fields. request.json "reply_format" gives the exact shape of each offered outcome: a reply needs status and text, a reject needs text and no status, a read has neither. The watcher reads it only if it is a regular file with one link that no process holds open for writing. In broker mode (--agy-broker) it reads it once, after every process of the turn has stopped. In session mode (--to-agy-session) it reads it every second: a valid reply finishes the job, and one that is not valid and stays the same for 60 seconds gives the sender a failed reply.

text.description: Not only white space; at most request.json "reply_max_bytes" UTF-8 bytes.
